text: This solution, Pakistan Hydromet and Climate Services Project (PHCSP/PHSCP) addresses natural catastrophe in Pakistan between Ministry of Climate Change & Environmental Coordination, National Disaster Risk Management Fund, Pakistan Meteorological Department, National Disaster Management Authority, International Development Association (IDA), and World Bank. The program was implemented in 2018 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
